title: Potato and Bean Bake with Sour Cream and Cheese
subtitle: layered white bean and tomato bake with cheddar mash
description: A spiced white bean and tomato base is topped with a coriander sour cream layer and cheddar mashed potato, then baked until golden and crisp. If you forgot to soak the beans, boil them three times in fresh water instead.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C and line a tray with baking paper. Bake the whole unpeeled potatoes for about 1 hour until soft.

Heat the olive oil in a wide pot and soften the chopped onion, diced carrot, celery, garlic and chilli for 5 minutes, stirring. Add the cumin, ground coriander and beans and cook for another 5 minutes.
Add the crushed tomatoes, season with salt and pepper and cook for another 10 minutes over medium heat, partly covered.
Mix the sour cream with the chopped coriander and spring onions.
Peel and mash the potatoes, season with salt and pepper and mix with the grated cheddar.
Spread the bean and tomato mixture in a deep Pyrex dish, cover with the sour cream mixture and top with the mash. Cover with foil.
Bake for 20 minutes, remove the foil and bake for another 10 minutes, or until the topping is golden and crisp.
